args.summary: checkout-api deployment v2.3.1 began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. Mitigation: rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version previously healthy in production, in all regions. Post-rollback status verified healthy in all three regions with an error rate of ~0.2%. Follow-up needed: investigate root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before re-attempting release.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent previously-healthy release in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions. Verified the service is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failure and mitigation; the on-call engineer was paged.

transcript.content: I'll first look at the deployment history and current service status to find the most recent healthy release.
transcript.reasoning_content: First, check deployment history and current status. List deployments to find the most recent healthy release.

transcript.content: The current deploy v2.3.1 is unhealthy across all regions (18% error rate). The most recent release that was healthy in production is **v2.3.0**. I'll roll back to it now.
transcript.reasoning_content: Latest deploy v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production. Most recent healthy release in production: v2.3.0 (seq 1). Rollback (in all regions) to v2.3.0. Then open SEV2 incident. Rollback first, then incident describing what I did.

transcript.content: The rollback to v2.3.0 succeeded in all three production regions. I'll verify it's healthy now, then open the SEV2 incident.
The rollback is confirmed healthy (error rate down from 18% to 0.2%). Now opening the SEV2 incident.
transcript.reasoning_content: Rolled back, healthy. Open SEV2 incident.
